summary: Iteration 10 tested: (1) proveedor bank fields (IBAN/Banco/BIC-SWIFT), (2) PDF attach + preview on facturas recibidas and albaranes compra, (3) object storage endpoints, (4) venta albarán does NOT show attach. Backend: 6/6 pytest passing. Frontend: all critical flows verified via Playwright including create, save, persistence on edit, and preview dialog with iframe.

issues: Dialog missing aria-describedby (React console warning). Non-blocking accessibility warning.

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to the Nuevo/Editar proveedor dialog to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Contactos schema uses field name 'swift' internally while UI label shows 'BIC / SWIFT' — testid input-swift used; consistent across backend/frontend.
POST /api/archivos/subir rejects non-PDF with 400 as expected; GET /api/archivos/{path:path} returns application/pdf inline (68 bytes body starts with %PDF).

Iframe rendering of PDF is blank in headless browser (Chromium PDF viewer disabled). Per task guidance, this is acceptable — iframe src correctly points at /api/archivos/... and backend GET returns application/pdf.
seed_data_creation: Created via tests: proveedor TEST_ProvBanco (backend), TEST_ProvUI (frontend), TEST_ProvFR, TEST_ProvAlb; a manual factura recibida with pdf; a compra albarán with pdf.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test env: pytest picks REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env if not exported. Documentos endpoints are /api/{entidad} (presupuestos|pedidos|albaranes) with tipo_operacion venta|compra in body. Contact bank field is 'swift'. PDF iframe visually blank in headless — validate by iframe src + backend content-type.
